annotation.title_clean: Regulation (EC) No 595/2009 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 18 June 2009 on type-approval of motor vehicles and engines with respect to emissions from heavy duty vehicles (Euro VI) and on access to vehicle repair and maintenance information
annotation.title_en: Regulation (EC) No 595/2009 on type-approval of motor vehicles and engines with respect to emissions from heavy duty vehicles (Euro VI) and on access to vehicle repair and maintenance information
annotation.authors_or_issuer: European Parliament and Council of the European Union
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union, L 188
annotation.summary_en: EU Regulation setting Euro VI type-approval requirements for emissions from heavy-duty vehicles and engines, including OBD systems, durability, in-service conformity, and unrestricted manufacturer access to repair and maintenance information for independent operators. It is unrelated to AI or robotics.
key_provisions_or_claims: Manufacturers must type-approve heavy-duty vehicles and engines to Euro VI emission limits in Annex I.
Defeat strategies that reduce emission control effectiveness are prohibited.
Manufacturers must give independent operators unrestricted, standardised access to OBD and repair information.
Tampering with consumable reagent (NOx) systems is prohibited and penalised.
Member States must set effective, proportionate, dissuasive penalties; the Commission adopts implementing measures by 1 April 2010.
